displayName: Work Response (actuals of a work order)
description: ISA-95 Part 4 cl. 8 (work performance model) WorkResponse: the actuals of one work order (WorkRequest); its job responses carry the actuals per job.

properties.name: work_response_id
properties.description: Identity of the work response: its own number from the source system.

properties.name: workorder_ref
properties.description: The work order (WorkRequest) this response answers (RESPONDS_TO).

properties.name: status
properties.description: Response state as the source names it (ISA-95 ResponseState).

properties.name: work_performance_ref
properties.description: The WorkPerformance this WorkResponse is part of (PART_OF; ISA-95 WorkPerformance MADE_UP_OF WorkResponse). Optional.

properties.name: parent_work_response_ref
properties.description: The WorkResponse this WorkResponse is part of (PART_OF; ISA-95 WorkResponse MADE_UP_OF WorkResponse). Optional.

properties.name: work_type
properties.description: ISA-95 work type (B2MML WorkType, the OperationsType code list; Part 4; audit M1). A source without the column sets the constant of the profile's momDomain (columnMappings const).

relationships.description: The work order this response answers (B2MML WorkResponse.WorkRequestID).

isa95.note: ISA-95 Part 4 cl. 8 WorkResponse = the response to a WorkRequest; made up of JobResponses (keyed on the job response side).
isa95.mappingNote: Self-nesting and containment are PART_OF on the child with a reference to the parent (B2MML nests the child inside the parent).
